title: Rust: DTN S-flag HBH option (0x03) ingress parity
description: Consumer follow-up from vectors bead 7mgm. rust/lichen-node routing ingress does not parse the DTN hop-by-hop option (Type=0x03, Length=5, Flags S=0x80, expiry u32 BE; spec/05-routing.md 9.8) — C router.c IPV6_HBH_OPT_DTN landed (with wall-clock fail-open in coap_dtn.c dtn_wall_clock). Rust survey_routing_headers walks TLV extensions by length so 0x03 survives the walk, but the S-flag/expiry are never extracted and DTN buffering decisions never see them. Implement: extract option in the ingress walk (stack.rs/receive.rs), set store-and-forward intent + absolute expiry per test/vectors/dtn_sflag_hbh.json (dtn_hbh cases), wire expiry decisions through the clockless fail-open rule (R-05-080). Consume the vectors in a rust test.
